title: 1dDW_Grad_o_Mat++
description: Manipulation of diffusion-weighted (DW) gradient vector files, b-value files, and b- or g-matrices with various input and output configurations.

in_row_vec.description: Input file of 3 rows of gradients (e.g., dcm2nii-format output)
in_row_vec.title: Input Row Vectors

in_col_vec.description: Input file of 3 columns of gradients
in_col_vec.title: Input Column Vectors

in_col_matA.description: Input file of 6 columns of b- or g-matrix in 'A(FNI)' diagonal first format
in_col_matA.title: Input Columns Matrix A

in_col_matT.description: Input file of 6 columns of b- or g-matrix in 'T(ORTOISE)' row first format
in_col_matT.title: Input Columns Matrix T

flip_x.description: Change sign of first column of gradients (or of the x-component parts of the matrix)
flip_x.title: Flip X

flip_y.description: Change sign of second column of gradients (or of the y-component parts of the matrix)
flip_y.title: Flip Y

flip_z.description: Change sign of third column of gradients (or of the z-component parts of the matrix)
flip_z.title: Flip Z

no_flip.description: Don't change any gradient/matrix signs (default behavior)
no_flip.title: No Flip

out_row_vec.description: Output file of 3 rows of gradients
out_row_vec.title: Output Row Vectors

out_col_vec.description: Output file of 3 columns of gradients
out_col_vec.title: Output Column Vectors

out_col_matA.description: Output file of 6 columns of b- or g-matrix in 'A(FNI)' diagonal first format
out_col_matA.title: Output Columns Matrix A

out_col_matT.description: Output file of 6 columns of b- or g-matrix in 'T(ORTOISE)' row first format
out_col_matT.title: Output Columns Matrix T

in_bvals.description: BVAL_FILE is a file of b-values either in a single row or a single column
in_bvals.title: Input B-Values

out_col_bval.description: Switch to put a column of the bvalues as the first column in the output data
out_col_bval.title: Output Column B-Values

out_row_bval_sep.description: Output a file of bvalues in a single row
out_row_bval_sep.title: Output Row B-Values File

out_col_bval_sep.description: Output a file of bvalues in a single column
out_col_bval_sep.title: Output Column B-Values File

unit_mag_out.description: Switch to scale each vector/matrix from the INFILE to either unit or zero magnitude
unit_mag_out.title: Unit Magnitude Output

check_abs_min.description: Specify the threshold to replace small negative diagonal elements with zero in the input matrix
check_abs_min.title: Check Absolute Minimum

bref_mean_top.description: When averaging the reference 'b0' values, represent the mean of X values in the top row
bref_mean_top.title: Reference Mean Top

put_zeros_top.description: Add a row at the top with all zeros in the output format
put_zeros_top.title: Put Zeros at Top

bmax_ref.description: THRESH is a scalar number below which b-values are considered zero or reference
bmax_ref.title: Maximum Reference B-Value Threshold
